summary: Intelligent Position Coach feature testing complete. Backend service (intelligent_position_coach.py) works correctly - all integration tests pass. Frontend PositionCoachingPanel component renders correctly. CRITICAL BUG FOUND: GET /api/coach/play/messages endpoint does NOT return position_coaching fields (structure_name, game_phase, strategic_plans, etc.) - only basic message fields. Frontend expects these fields but receives null/undefined.

issues.description: GET /api/coach/play/messages/{session_id} endpoint does not include position_coaching fields in response. The backend STORES all fields correctly when creating the message (lines 9946-9960 in server.py), but the GET endpoint (lines 10086-10125) only returns basic fields (id, type, message, trigger, move, move_number, timestamp). Missing fields: structure_name, structure_type, game_phase, key_characteristics, strategic_plans, tactical_features, tactical_insights, teaching_points, critical_squares, options. The frontend expects these fields to render PositionCoachingPanel.
issues.reproduction:
1. Start a coach game
2. Make 12+ moves to trigger position coaching
3. Poll messages endpoint
4. Observe position_coaching messages missing fields
issues.affected_test: TestPositionCoachingMessageStorage::test_position_coaching_message_structure (currently passes because position coaching rarely triggers, but will fail when it does)

issues.description: Add handling for position_coaching type messages in get_coach_messages endpoint to include all fields like opening_teaching_offer and endgame_teaching_offer types

action_items: FIX: Add position_coaching field handling in GET /api/coach/play/messages endpoint (server.py around line 10110). Add: if msg.get('type') == 'position_coaching': msg_data['structure_name'] = msg.get('structure_name'); msg_data['structure_type'] = msg.get('structure_type'); msg_data['game_phase'] = msg.get('game_phase'); msg_data['key_characteristics'] = msg.get('key_characteristics'); msg_data['strategic_plans'] = msg.get('strategic_plans'); msg_data['tactical_features'] = msg.get('tactical_features'); msg_data['tactical_insights'] = msg.get('tactical_insights'); msg_data['teaching_points'] = msg.get('teaching_points'); msg_data['critical_squares'] = msg.get('critical_squares'); msg_data['options'] = msg.get('options')
context_for_next_testing_agent: Position coaching feature is implemented but has a critical bug in the messages endpoint. The intelligent_position_coach.py service works correctly. PawnStructureClassifier, StructurePlanDatabase, DetectorRegistry, and position_strategy_analyzer all work. The frontend PositionCoachingPanel component is correctly implemented with data-testid attributes. Test files created: /app/backend/tests/test_intelligent_position_coach.py (20 tests) and /app/tests/e2e/position-coaching.spec.ts (7 tests). The bug prevents position coaching data from reaching the frontend even when triggered.
rca_of_issue: Root Cause: In server.py get_coach_messages endpoint, there's handling for 'opening_teaching_offer' and 'endgame_teaching_offer' message types to include their specific fields, but NO handling for 'position_coaching' type. The code pattern is established (lines 10097-10109) but position_coaching was not added. Fix: Add similar if-block for position_coaching type after line 10109.
